reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text: So far so great... I've been using it for around 2 weeks and it has help a lot with the hydration of my skin. It is not heavy at all, it hasn't irritated my skin and it provides a beautiful brightness to the skin. I've fallen in love with this product and the way it makes my skin feel. Worth giving it a try.
reviews.zh: 暫時用得好滿意……用咗大概 2 星期，幫咗皮膚好多保濕。完全唔厚重，冇刺激到我塊面，仲做到好好嘅提亮效果。已經愛上呢件產品，同佢畀我嘅膚觸。值得一試。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text: Quite good, moisturizing and it really lasts a long way, it’s watery when you pour but feels more like a serum when you apply it to the skin. And literally just 3-4 drops are enough, else it’s to much🤭
reviews.zh: 幾好用，保濕而且用得好襟，倒出嚟時水水的，但搽上皮膚就似精華。3-4 滴就夠，多咗會太多🤭

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text: Tenía muchas expectativas y la verdad que no sentí nada de humectacion.
reviews.zh: 本來期望好高，但老實講完全感覺唔到保濕。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text:
As someone buying their second bottle, I can confidently say this serum earns every bit of its praise. It keeps skin glass-skin smooth, plump, and glowing—without burdening my wallet. Perfect as a hydrating step in both morning and evening routines.

Tip: Apply on damp skin or right after toner to enhance absorption and seal in hydration.
reviews.zh:
已經買第二支，我可以好肯定咁講，呢支精華絕對當得起所有讚譽。保持肌膚玻璃肌嘅滑、飽滿、有光澤——價錢又唔貴。日間夜間護膚程序嘅保濕步驟都好啱用。

小貼士：喺微濕嘅皮膚上或者用完爽膚水後即刻搽，可以加強吸收同鎖住水分。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text: I swear this serum fixed my skin! I had bad foreheads bumps for months after moving to a new city. when i went to korea and got a facial she told me i should prioritize cleansing and moisturizing. at first I just used moisturizer at night but saw small difference. after purchasing this serum and using it every night for 3 months now, i have significantly less stubborn bumps or breakouts! on most days I have completely clear skin.
reviews.zh: 我發誓呢支精華救返我塊面！搬咗去新城市之後，額頭嘅暗粒嚴重咗幾個月。去韓國做 facial 嗰陣，美容師話我應該注重清潔同保濕。初期淨係夜晚搽保濕霜，睇唔到太大分別。買咗呢支精華，每晚用，到依家已經 3 個月，暗粒同爆瘡明顯少咗好多！大部分日子皮膚都好清透。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text: This might be one of my favorite hyaluronic toners. It isnt as liquidy as other hydrating toners but that's a huge perk to me. This is a toner I can use year round and also do a couple layers of to boost hydration.
reviews.zh: 這可能係我最鍾意嘅透明質酸爽膚水之一。佢冇其他保濕爽膚水咁水，但對我嚟講呢個係一個好大嘅優點。呢款爽膚水我全年都用到，亦可以做多幾層嚟加強保濕。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text: If I’m being honest I really got it because of the bear logo but I tried it out and love taht it makes my skin glow and very moisturize my skin and I do have dry skin and I’m love this and I would definitely get it again.
reviews.zh: 老實講，我真係因為個熊仔 logo 先買嘅，但我試完之後好鍾意佢令到我塊面有光澤同好保濕，我係乾性肌，我好鍾意呢款產品，一定會再買。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 300ml
reviews.text: as expected it is super soothing and feels very hydrating. the bottle is huge so i don’t think ill run out anytime soon. and i love the consistency. not to jelly like and not too watery.
reviews.zh: 同預期一樣，超級舒緩，感覺好保濕。支裝容量好大，應該好耐都唔會用完。我好鍾意佢嘅質地，唔會太杰身，亦唔會太稀。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
